about: Obsession's single source of pricing. Primitives are what we pay (wholesale). Pieces are what we sell one by one. Plans bundle pieces. Blueprints state what one run uses in primitives, and each tier states how many units, how often and at what target margin. engine.js turns these into every price: cost at full use / (1 - margin), rounded up to the ladder. No price is typed anywhere in this file except the retail piece prices and the plan prices, which are set by the founders and checked against wholesale here.
